source_note: Hand-built sample set — real, currently-existing course titles and providers, written from general knowledge (not scraped or fetched live). Fallback for the missing Coursera/Udemy MCP connectors, per user instruction. Treat as representative, not verbatim listings. estimated_hours is a rough hand estimate for path-fitting purposes, not a scraped/official figure. Added for the multi-role rework (see CLAUDE.md) alongside seed_ml_engineer.json and seed_frontend_developer.json.

courses.title: IBM Data Science Professional Certificate
courses.description: A multi-course program covering Python, SQL, data analysis, data visualization, and machine learning, aimed at learners with no prior data science background.

courses.title: Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate
courses.description: Covers the full data analysis process: data cleaning, spreadsheets, SQL, and data visualization with Tableau, aimed at learners with no prior analytics background.

courses.title: Python for Data Science and Machine Learning Bootcamp
courses.description: A hands-on introduction to the Python data science stack: NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn, and scikit-learn, building toward practical machine learning projects.

courses.title: Statistics with Python Specialization
courses.description: Covers inferential statistics, sampling, and statistical modeling in Python, aimed at learners who already know basic Python.

courses.title: Machine Learning Specialization
courses.description: Andrew Ng's foundational specialization covering supervised and unsupervised learning, regression, classification, and neural network basics with scikit-learn and TensorFlow.

courses.title: Deep Learning Specialization
courses.description: Covers neural networks, convolutional networks, sequence models, and how to structure machine learning projects, using Python and TensorFlow.

courses.title: SQL for Data Science
courses.description: An introduction to SQL for querying and filtering data, aimed at learners with no prior database experience.

courses.title: A/B Testing and Experiment Design for Data Analysts
courses.description: Covers designing controlled experiments, sample size calculation, and interpreting statistical significance for product and marketing decisions.

courses.title: Data Visualization with Python
courses.description: Covers building charts and dashboards in Python using Matplotlib, Seaborn, and Folium.

courses.title: Data Science Math Skills
courses.description: Covers the set theory, probability, and combinatorics foundations needed before tackling statistics and machine learning coursework.
